title: How to write a resume that actually gets interviews 🔎
description:
If you want to get hired in this job market, your resume needs to read that you're qualified for the specific job, not any job. The Teal Resume Builder’s Matching Mode can give you a list of keywords from the job description that you need to have show up in your resume. Work the hard skill keywords into your resume achievements to show proficiency in the job requirements and look for your match score to at least get to 70%. #resume #resumetips #resumetip #resumebuilder
